paper_record.title: Entangling Topological Invariants
paper_record.abstract: An isolated occupied multiplet may admit local tensor-product descriptions without a globally consistent subsystem structure. We characterize the obstruction by comparing the transition functions of the occupied multiplet with those generated by independent basis changes in the two candidate subsystems. When a decomposition into rank-one sectors over a closed surface is specified, the resulting quotient removes row- and column-additive Chern data and yields mixed Chern classes. Momentum-dependent mixing of the sector labels adds the Gauss--Codazzi curvature of the moving lines, while in the label-conserving limit the mixed class is measured by a crossed Thouless pump. When only the factor dimensions $p$ and $q$ are specified, the comparison is made at the level of the clutching map of a rank-$pq$ bundle over $S^4$. Product frames generate winding numbers in $q\mathbb Z+p\mathbb Z$, so global factorization is possible exactly when $C_2$ is divisible by $\gcd(p,q)$; in particular, odd $C_2$ obstructs a $2\times2$ factorization. We illustrate the two settings with finite eight-level Hamiltonians and give pumping and occupied-projector tomography protocols for their readout.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文研究了将多带占据态全局分解为子系统张量积的拓扑阻碍，并提出了相应的量子测量协议。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper investigates the topological obstruction to globally factorizing occupied multiband states into subsystem tensor products and proposes corresponding quantum readout protocols.

problem.zh: 如何表征和测量将多带系统中的占据态全局分解为独立子系统（如自旋、轨道等）张量积的拓扑阻碍。
problem.en: How to characterize and measure the topological obstruction to globally factorizing occupied states in multiband systems into tensor products of independent subsystems.

approach.zh: 利用子系统粘合商群比较占据态的变换函数与独立子系统基底变换的差异，在二维表面和四维球面上分别通过混合陈数和挂钩映射进行分析，并设计了基于三超导量子比特的断层扫描与泵浦协议。
approach.en: Using a subsystem-gluing quotient to compare occupied-state transition functions with independent subsystem basis changes, analyzing them via mixed Chern classes on 2D surfaces and clutching maps on S4, and designing tomography and pumping protocols on a three-transmon register.

main_takeaway.zh: 全局子系统因式分解的拓扑阻碍由混合陈数（二维）或第二陈数对子系统维度最大公约数的整除性（四维）决定，且该阻碍可以通过交叉泵浦或变换函数断层扫描来测量。
main_takeaway.en: The topological obstruction to global subsystem factorization is determined by mixed Chern classes (in 2D) or the divisibility of the second Chern number by the greatest common divisor of subsystem dimensions (on S4), which can be measured via crossed pumping or transition-function tomography.

why_it_matters.zh: 它为多带拓扑材料中局部自由度（如自旋、谷）的全局独立性提供了严格的拓扑判据，对拓扑量子计算和量子模拟具有重要意义。
why_it_matters.en: It provides a rigorous topological criterion for the global independence of local degrees of freedom (e.g., spin, valley) in multiband topological materials, which is important for topological quantum computing and quantum simulation.

reason.zh: 本文阐明了子系统全局因式分解的拓扑阻碍机制，并为超导量子比特系统设计了具体的实验读取方案。
reason.en: The paper clarifies the topological obstruction mechanism for global subsystem factorization and designs concrete experimental readout protocols for superconducting qubit systems.

reason.zh: 论文结合了凝聚态拓扑物理与量子信息表征，提出了新颖的拓扑不变量测量方案，适合发表于物理学顶级期刊。
reason.en: The paper combines condensed matter topological physics with quantum information characterization, proposing a novel scheme to measure topological invariants, making it highly suitable for a top physics journal.
